name: Flash
description: A high-tempo striker who turns clean answers into short pressure spikes.
passive: Overclock: while your ultimate is active, each correct adds a Power stack (max 4). Every stack adds a flat damage chip on your next hits; a wrong answer removes two stacks instead of wiping you clean.
ultimateDescription: 8 seconds. Each correct adds Power (up to 4). Each Power stack adds flat bonus damage on your attacks. Wrong answers strip 2 stacks.

name: Shadow
description: A disruptor that shrinks the opponent's decision space.
passive: Neural Jam: on ult, the opponent is visibly jammed and gets brief input-lock windows that disrupt rhythm without piling on extra punishment.
ultimateDescription: 8 seconds. Opponent is visibly JAMMED and gets brief input-lock windows that interrupt answer flow.

name: Guardian
description: A defensive specialist built around surviving pressure with a fortified window.
passive: Reflect Bastion: while your ultimate is up you take much less damage for a short window, letting you outlast enemy pressure without adding a burst finisher.
ultimateDescription: 8 seconds. You heavily mitigate incoming hits for a short fortified window.

name: Blaze
description: A burn specialist that ramps damage over the ultimate window.
passive: Blaze Surge: correct answers add burn stacks while your ultimate is active. Burn ticks chip the opponent; wrong answers shave one stack.
ultimateDescription: 8 seconds. Correct answers add burn stacks; burn ticks every ~0.9s. Wrong answers remove one stack.

name: Architect
howItPlays: Perfect System: activate a 10-second systems window, build nodes with correct answers, then release them at the perfect moment for a capped burst.
description: Activate a 10-second systems window. Correct answers build up to 5 System Nodes. Release them manually for a powerful capped burst, or let the system auto-release when time expires. Wrong answers remove a node.
passive: Perfect System stores up to 5 System Nodes during the active window. Correct answers add a node, wrong answers remove one, and releasing the system converts the stored nodes into a capped burst.
ultimateDescription: 10 seconds (premium). Correct answers build up to 5 System Nodes. Release early for a capped burst, or auto-release when the window ends. Wrong answers remove 1 node.

name: Titan
howItPlays: Colossus Mode: enter a 10-second heavy power state. Your hits slam harder and heal you slightly, but every hit creates a short recovery delay.
description: Enter a 10-second heavy power state. Correct answers land massive hits and restore some HP, but each hit creates a short recovery delay. Wrong answers still punish you.
passive: Colossus Mode boosts hit damage, grants slight lifesteal and resistance, but forces a short recovery delay after each empowered hit.
ultimateDescription: 10 seconds (premium). Correct answers hit harder and restore some HP, but each empowered hit causes a short recovery delay. Wrong answers still punish you.
